parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is in the infrastructure layer. Every method in ProductRepository does persistence work only: it stores, retrieves, lists, deletes and checks for Product aggregates in an in-memory Map. That fits the role of an infrastructure repository. There are no business rules, no validation and no domain invariants. It does not shape transport data or build DTOs. The @Injectable decorator is NestJS framework wiring, and that belongs in infrastructure. The application handlers inject this concrete class instead of a port, but that is a dependency-direction question and out of scope here.
